commentary.commentary: Pop Lockett Drop it suffered a brutal 6.0-point loss to Joe Mantegna, snapping their three-game winning streak. Leaving 11.5 points on the bench by starting Kenneth Walker III over KC Concepcion Jr. proved costly.
ThreatLevelMidnight bounced back from a two-game skid by crushing Uncle Rico 155.18 to 103.60. The dominant win marks a major career milestone of 75 wins for the franchise.

A four-game winning streak came to a heartbreaking end for The Big Gronkowski after a narrow 131.52 to 126.24 defeat against Voldemort. Despite near-flawless lineup management leaving just 0.1 points on the bench, they suffered a brutal bad beat.

Joe Mantegna pulled off a tight 121.22 to 115.22 victory over Pop Lockett Drop it with a pristine 100 percent lineup efficiency. Active roster tinkering continued mid-week with the additions of the Patriots defense and Tre Tucker.
